title: api-gateway SSL certificate expired
root_cause: SSL certificate not renewed before expiry date
resolution: Renewed certificate via GCP Certificate Manager and re-attached to load balancer backend service
lessons: Add monitoring alert for certificate expiry approaching 30 days

title: payment-service intermittent downtime
root_cause: Memory leak causing OOMKill under sustained load, combined with inadequate HPA min-replicas causing single-pod SPOF during restart
resolution: Increased memory limit, raised HPA minReplicas to 2, deployed patched image with memory leak fix
lessons: Always set minReplicas >= 2 for prod workloads; add OOMKill alert per pod
